# runzero_agent (Resource)

Manages a RunZero agent. Agents are deployed externally and adopted into Terraform by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the agent.

### Optional

- `site_id` (String) The site ID the agent is associated with.

### Read-Only

- `arch` (String) The architecture of the agent host.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the agent is currently connected.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the agent was created.
- `deactivated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the agent was deactivated.
- `external_ip` (String) The external IP address of the agent.
- `inactive` (Boolean) Whether the agent is inactive.
- `internal_ip` (String) The internal IP address of the agent.
- `last_checkin` (Number) Unix timestamp of the agent's last check-in.
- `name` (String) The name of the agent.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the agent belongs to.
- `os` (String) The operating system of the agent host.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the agent was last updated.
- `version` (String) The version of the agent.
